Name: OpenFire and Belos for Mobile Phone
Author: CyrusMeadow
Description:
Hello, I know these mods are old but I couldn't find a mod that integrated Belos and OpenFire's Heart Events with the Mobile Phone mod and decided to see if I could figure out how to do it and just decided to post it here. This is a very simple small mod so I just put them both together, but [b]you do not need both of them[/b].

I couldn't find the original names of the events (if they have them) so apologies if the titles are lackluster as I am not good at coming up with names.

Just put the mod in the Mods file with the rest of your mods and it should work! 

------

Also, I don't know if anyone else is having this problem where Belos's 10 Heart Event just stops in the middle but if you do;

[b]Please keep in mind this file has all the dialogue of event ten.[/b]
Go to [CP] Belos\assets\Events\10.json

Press Ctrl+f and look for "So this" (without the quotation marks, with capital s) or scroll all the way to the right and just look for it yourself.

You will see: [b]\"/pause 500/message\"So this 
[/b]Change it to: [b]\"/pause 500/message \"So this 

[/b]So that there is a space in between 'message' and the backward slash.

------

If there's any problems with the mod please let me know, I will do my best to fix it.
